## Description
What changed and why. Link the issue it closes (`Closes #123`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring

## Checklist
- [ ] `make check && pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `AGENTIC_MANUAL.md` / README updated if the behavior of the client changed
- [ ] No breaking change (or it is described above)
